label: Radio goes into the cars
detail: Colin Anderson splits Craig Conner's demos into seven genre stations; DJ and ad ideas are held back by memory and budget.

label: Houser and Lazlow write GTA III's radio
detail: Lazlow's company is hired; the pair write the ads, which Lazlow produces from his home studio.

label: Love Fist on V-Rock
detail: Vice City adds the fictional band Love Fist, with Lazlow as V-Rock's head DJ.

label: Celebrities voice San Andreas DJs
detail: Axl Rose, Chuck D and George Clinton voice invented DJs on K-DST, Playback FM and Bounce FM.

label: Phil Collins in Vice City Stories
detail: The first real celebrity to appear as himself in a GTA game, per Guinness; an in-game concert, not a radio show.

label: Reactive DJs and mission bulletins
detail: Rockstar's audio team says GTA IV DJs react to time, weather and events, and Weazel News updates through the story.

label: Kavinsky station rumor
detail: Per the GTA wiki, Kavinsky was reported as host of a planned GTA V station, Nightride FM, that never appeared. Rumor.

label: GTA V introduces the radio wheel
detail: The radial station picker replaces the linear selector, per the GTA wiki.

label: Nightclub residents on the radio
detail: After Hours puts four resident DJs' mixes on Los Santos Underground Radio, unlocked through setup missions.

label: Lazlow leaves Rockstar
detail: After nine GTA games he joins Dan Houser at Absurd Ventures.

label: Kult FM's absent host
detail: Cayo Perico adds Kult FM, where Julian Casablancas never reaches the booth and producer Zachary (David Cross) fills in.

label: Dr. Dre tracks tied to The Contract
detail: Six new Dr. Dre tracks join Radio Los Santos alongside The Contract's missions.

label: Lazlow on his character
detail: Lazlow says Houser made the in-game Lazlow worse each game.

label: GTA VI talk radio and podcasts
detail: Rockstar previews six stations and confirms talk radio plus character podcasts for Jason and Lucia.
